abstract_sentences.text: Large Language Models (LLMs) are pre-trained on large amounts of data from different sources and domains.
abstract_sentences.transition: opens with object and data-source context

evidence.anchor: pre-trained on large amounts of data from different sources and domains

abstract_sentences.text: Such datasets often contain trillions of tokens, including large portions of copyrighted or proprietary content, which raises questions about the legal use of such models.

evidence.anchor: copyrighted or proprietary content

abstract_sentences.text: This underscores the need for truly open pre-training data that complies with data security regulations.
abstract_sentences.transition: answers sentence 2 with a compliance requirement

evidence.anchor: need for truly open pre-training data

abstract_sentences.text: In this paper, we introduce Common Corpus, the largest open dataset for LLM pre-training.

evidence.anchor: we introduce Common Corpus, the largest open dataset

abstract_sentences.text: The data assembled in Common Corpus are either uncopyrighted or under open licenses, totaling about two trillion tokens.

evidence.anchor: either uncopyrighted or under open licenses, totaling about two trillion tokens

abstract_sentences.text: The dataset contains a wide variety of languages, ranging from the high-resource European languages to some low-resource languages rarely represented in pre-training datasets.

evidence.anchor: wide variety of languages ... low-resource languages

abstract_sentences.text: In addition, it includes a large amount of code data.
abstract_sentences.transition: adds code as a distinct data type

evidence.anchor: large amount of code data

abstract_sentences.text: The diversity of data sources in terms of covered domains and time periods opens up the paths for both research and entrepreneurial needs across diverse areas of knowledge.

evidence.anchor: covered domains and time periods

abstract_sentences.text: In this paper, we present the detailed provenance of data assembling and the details of dataset filtering and curation.

evidence.anchor: detailed provenance ... filtering and curation

abstract_sentences.text: We train two small language models on Common Corpus and find that they perform comparably to other models of their size, indicating that our dataset is suitable for multilingual pretraining.
abstract_sentences.transition: links model evaluation to dataset suitability

evidence.anchor: perform comparably to other models of their size

abstract_sentences.text: Common Corpus represents a key contribution to the ecosystem for open science research on Large Language Models.

evidence.anchor: key contribution to the ecosystem for open science research

introduction_moves.current_answer: GPT-3 used 300B tokens; documented 2025 models use 14–36T tokens, making data scale foundational.
introduction_moves.next_hook: Data quality, maintenance and filtering become costly.

evidence.anchor: Large Language Models demand large amounts of training data

introduction_moves.previous_problem: How can enough data be collected without hidden legal and social costs?
introduction_moves.current_answer: Public availability does not establish public-domain status; fair-use dependence, NYT litigation, C4 restrictions and crawler pressure define the legal and social gap.
introduction_moves.next_hook: The next paragraph grounds the gap in removed research artifacts.

evidence.anchor: web data is publicly available, it is not always in the public domain

introduction_moves.previous_problem: What happens when legal uncertainty reaches released artifacts?
introduction_moves.current_answer: Books3, LAION, GEITje and MATH are cited as takedown examples; sudden removal makes prior work unreplicable and costs smaller developers.
introduction_moves.next_hook: Restrictions also affect data that has not yet been taken down.

evidence.anchor: removed suddenly, making previous work unreplicable

introduction_moves.previous_problem: Is the web an enduring source even before a takedown?
introduction_moves.current_answer: C4, RefinedWeb and Dolma are used to show restricted use growing, with high-quality sources disproportionately affected.
introduction_moves.next_hook: Existing open initiatives are compared by language and domain scope.

evidence.anchor: 5% of all tokens in C4 now have restricted use

introduction_moves.previous_problem: Can existing permissive collections cover multiple languages and domains?
introduction_moves.current_answer: C4C, Open License Corpus, KL3M and Common Pile cover parts of the need, but the authors characterize the newer large efforts as monolingual or narrowly scoped.
introduction_moves.next_hook: A unified multilingual, multidomain, fully open corpus is needed.

evidence.anchor: All these projects are monolingual

introduction_moves.previous_problem: No compared collection simultaneously supplies the desired openness, size, language and domain range.
introduction_moves.current_answer: Common Corpus is positioned as about 2T tokens, fully open and highly multilingual, while the open-data paradox limits coverage.
introduction_moves.next_hook: The paper will detail composition and curation, then test small models.

evidence.anchor: largest fully open pre-training dataset at about 2 trillion tokens

introduction_moves.previous_problem: How will the proposed corpus be made auditable and useful?
introduction_moves.current_answer: The paper promises composition, collection/curation and license-clearing details, plus two small-model comparisons; it explicitly says coverage is incomplete.
introduction_moves.next_hook: Section 2 defines open and the corpus infrastructure.

evidence.anchor: detail the composition ... collection and curation, and license clearing

related_work_moves.previous_problem: How do contemporary open pre-training datasets differ?
related_work_moves.current_answer: Table 1 lays out eight datasets against four binary properties.

evidence.anchor: Table 1

related_work_moves.previous_problem: What prevents prior datasets from satisfying all four properties?
related_work_moves.current_answer: KL3M is English legal/administrative, Dolma is mainly English, and Common Pile is English-only despite open and varied data.
related_work_moves.next_hook: The paper states Common Corpus is unique under the chosen matrix.

evidence.anchor: limited to administrative and legal documents in English

related_work_moves.previous_problem: Can any adjacent dataset combine the four criteria?
related_work_moves.current_answer: The authors claim Common Corpus uniquely satisfies them.
related_work_moves.next_hook: A source-level overlap comparison tests whether it merely duplicates crawl corpora.

evidence.anchor: unique in satisfying all four criteria simultaneously

related_work_moves.previous_problem: Does the corpus add content beyond existing web collections?
related_work_moves.current_answer: FineWeb top-1000 overlap is reported below 2% of pages and 1% of domains; Common Corpus emphasizes PDFs while crawl pipelines retrieve HTML.
related_work_moves.next_hook: Provenance section identifies the six sources.

evidence.anchor: less than 2% of pages and 1% of domain names

lexical_profile.scope: 正文 p1–10；排除 references、公式碎片、表格数值和页眉。
lexical_profile.rhetorical_assessment: Domain nouns and collection names dominate; strong terms largest/only/unique/key contribution/outstanding position the release, while comparably/hope/may/far from/limited-size bound efficacy and scope.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 以许可可追溯、公共领域核验和 OCR/PII/toxicity 清洗，把多源多语言资料组织成约 2T-token 开放 corpus，再用两个小模型和 multilingual benchmarks 给出有限预训练可用性证据。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 六 collection 概念、总量、核心 provenance、清洗工具选择、PII/毒性处理、两模型规模与 H100 hours、三个 benchmark 和 Table 2 aggregate scores。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 总量分解、许可证和语言长尾、来源表、权利规则、工具训练数据与例子、Figure 4 指标定义及逐语言分数移入 Appendix A–G；seed、完整超参数和 component ablation 仍未给出。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Table 1 的四维 ✓/✗ taxonomy 建立定位，Figure 3 并置时间与语义差异，Table 2 用三行数字绑定 corpus utility 与模型规模；collection 段落沿来源—许可—用途推进。
final_judgment.largest_gap: fully open、ethical 和 suitable for pre-training 的范围强于直接证据：内部权利规则不是独立法律证明，清洗没有 removal/alternative ablation，Table 2 没有 seed/区间/matched controls 且两个任务落后强基线。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 数据治理型论文应在正文把治理约束、可复核数据对象和预先声明的效能检验串成一条闭环，并保留会改变决策的分母、对照和异质性摘要。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 规则适用于 dataset、benchmark、 infrastructure 和 model-card 型论文；纯理论论文应改用假设—定理—反例或实验预测闭环，不要求不存在的数据治理字段。
